formulas_and_math.verbatim_text: phi^LL(S,Y) := - sum_{k=1}^K Y_k log S_k;  phi^BS(S,Y) := sum_{k=1}^K (S_k - Y_k)^2
formulas_and_math.context: Proper scoring rules for probability vectors; corresponding divergences are KL and squared error.
The terms are calibration loss CL, grouping loss GL, and irreducible loss IL.

formulas_and_math.verbatim_text: GECE(g) = sum_{B in mathbb{B}} (|B|/|mathbb{B}|) d(gbar_B, ybar_B)
formulas_and_math.context: Bins are formed after applying the lens output transformation; d compares average lensed outputs and targets.

formulas_and_math.verbatim_text: d_[l,h](g, ybar) = max(0, max(l - ybar, ybar - h))
formulas_and_math.context: A non-metric distance for Likert-style confidence intervals; error occurs when mean label lies outside [l,h].

formulas_and_math.verbatim_text: d_phi(x,y) = phi(x) - phi(y) - nabla phi(y)^T(x-y); E[d_phi(Z,X)] = [E phi(Z) - E phi(E[Z|X])] + E[d_phi(E[Z|X],X)]
formulas_and_math.context: The first bracket is the sharpness gap and the second term is calibration error; L2 ECE is the ECE induced by a Bregman divergence.
A and B are fitted by maximum likelihood; f_i is the uncalibrated classifier output.

formulas_and_math.verbatim_text: minimize sum_i (y_i - fhat_i)^2 subject to fhat_i >= fhat_j whenever f_i >= f_j

formulas_and_math.context: T is learned by minimizing log_loss on a hold-out calibration set and does not change the argmax accuracy.

Daily Fantasy Fuel says its projections were independently verified, but gives no model details.; [https://www.linestarapp.com/Projections] LineStar identifies its projection as proprietary and editable and provides an aggregate industry consensus. RotoWire states it uses RotoWire projections. SaberSim states it simulates contests thousands of times for ROI.
